T: Taste. Don't eat. Then order the cheeseburger.
D: A couple join a handful of rich guests at an exclusive island restaurant where the tasting menu turns sinister.
P: Serve the cheeseburgers when Margot asks the chef for one.
S: the bread course with no bread
A bowl of cultured butter, olive oil, whipped ricotta and a few flakes of salt. Then, because you're not on that island, a warm sourdough loaf to go with them.
the first course, served on a rock
Scallops sliced thin and dressed with lime, finger lime, a few drops of good olive oil and sea salt, set on a cold stone or a chilled plate.
the tortillas with the guests' secrets printed on them
Corn tortillas warmed on a hot dry pan, served with a salsa of charred tomato, chipotle and coriander and a smear of smashed avocado.
M: the one thing on the menu worth eating
Chuck mince smashed thin on a smoking griddle, two patties, American cheese, white onion and pickles on a soft toasted bun, crinkle-cut fries. Pack one to go.
a tasting menu main, without the theatre
Lamb rack roasted at 200C to 56C, rested, carved, with a celeriac purée, charred leeks and a red wine jus.
W: the final course, with a bonfire
Biscuit crumb base, dark chocolate ganache set inside, topped with a toasted marshmallow meringue torched until blistered.
K: A chilled white and a light red poured in small tasting glasses, swapped course by course.

s.note: the bread course with no bread
s.how: Set out a bowl of 125g cultured butter, a dish of olive oil and 150g whipped ricotta, each with a few salt flakes. Then, because you're not on that island, warm a sourdough loaf and serve it with them.

s.note: the first course, served on a rock
s.how: Slice 300g very fresh scallops thin and lay on chilled plates. Dress with the juice of a lime, the pearls of 2 finger limes, a few drops of olive oil and sea salt. Serve straight away.

m.note: the one thing on the menu worth eating
m.how: Smash 8 thin patties from 800g chuck mince on a smoking griddle and add American cheese. Stack two per soft toasted bun with white onion and pickles. Fry 1kg potatoes crinkle-cut, twice. Wrap one to take home.

w.note: the final course, with a bonfire
w.how: Press 250g crushed biscuits with 100g melted butter into a tart tin. Pour in 200g dark chocolate melted with 200ml cream and set. Whisk 3 whites with 150g sugar over hot water, beat stiff, spread on top and torch until blistered.

d.how: Chill a 750ml bottle of white wine and slightly chill a 750ml pinot noir. Pour small amounts into tasting glasses, swapping course by course. Don't ask for the cheeseburger until the end.
